test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Slender
solution:
The correct answer is **Frail**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** synonym for the given word '**Slender**' is '**Frail**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Slender**' is '**(used about a person or part of somebody’s body) thin in an attractive way**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Frail**' is '**weak or not healthy**'.
 
• Hence, the **appropriate** answer is '**Frail**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Lively**- full of energy, interest, excitement, etc.
 
• **Energetic**- full of or needing energy and enthusiasm.
 
• **Defame**- to harm somebody by saying or writing bad or false things about him/her.
